note: Changes to a barre reached on beat 1: Am to the full F with a strum on every beat, G to Bm with the hand leaving early, then F inside a four-chord round with the island strum. The old tempo Stage selector is now moves (60 to 84 bpm in steps of 12, the later blocks kept 6 and 10 above), so the text names no selector; each block has one extra line, a feel or what to do when a change comes late.

exercise.title: Changes to a barre in time
exercise.why: A change to a barre comes late when your hand stays on the old chord until its last strum, so each block here asks for the barre on beat 1 with less time to get there.

cells.text:
Press Play below to start the metronome at {{=bpm}}. After a bar of count-in, the lit box shows the chord to play: strum down on every beat, a bar of Am and a bar of F.
If F comes late, leave out the last strum of the Am bar and use that beat to move.

Press Play below to start the metronome and strum down on every beat, a bar of G and a bar of Bm.
Let go of G on the last beat of its bar, so your hand is already moving when Bm is due.

Press Play below to start the metronome. The strokes in each box are the strum for the bar: play them through Am, F, C and G, a bar each.
Practice until the F bar sounds as full as the other three.

tool.pattern: D . D U . U D U
